'first' (often not a count; check): "Norway's allied pick, its first upstream or midstream sector on the Strategic Index after a resource-base screen, is upstream batteries, ranked 6th and almost tied with upstream electric grid (0.000 apart)."

143 words: "Scores compare Norway with other economies in the same sector; they are not measures of risk or profit in absolute terms. All index values are the paper's baseline as of 12 October 2026; Strategic Insights recomputes them under other weightings. Some of Norway's sectors are not placed: a score is compared with other economies only when the economy is sovereign and at most half of the score rests on filled-in data. Strategic Index scores within 0.01 of each other are almost tied: small changes in the data or the weights can swap their order. Many allied picks are close calls: in the paper, 37% of them are within 0.01 of the runner-up. Industrial-policy measures from the Global Trade Alert, New Industrial Policy Observatory, October 2026 extract (as of 5 October 2026) are context only, outside the Policy index. Country Insights shows the detail."
